content:
Rumors suggest that the AirPods 5 will be announced next week alongside the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12, as well as the iPhone Ultra. Here's what's known so far about the new AirPods.

The AirPods 5 are expected to debut at the September 9 event in two models, but without cameras

Apple's biggest event of the year will be held next week on September 9. In addition to new iPhone and Apple Watch models, there may also be home products, and the AirPods 5 are also expected to launch simultaneously.

The AirPods 4 launched in 2024, and historically, Apple has released each generation of AirPods two to three years apart. AirPods debuted in 2016, AirPods 2 in 2019, AirPods 3 in 2021, and AirPods 4 in 2024. So based on this timeline, a release this year roughly fits the pattern.

However, surprisingly, there haven't been many rumors or leaks about the new AirPods.

Most recent AirPods rumors have centered on a new model equipped with cameras. Earlier, a video leaked from Apple software showed a model with cameras, leading to speculation that it would launch soon.

However, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says that AirPods with cameras won't arrive until 2027. But he expects the AirPods 5 without cameras to make its debut at Apple's September event. He recently wrote:

Gurman added in a post on X that the AirPods 5 will come in two different models:

  • With active noise cancellation
  • Without active noise cancellation

In an earlier report, Gurman mentioned that he doesn't expect the AirPods 5 to adopt the heart rate sensor from the AirPods Pro 3, but that Apple "is exploring gradually adding more health features to AirPods, including a body temperature sensor." He also separately mentioned that Apple "is developing an H3 chip, aimed at reducing latency and improving audio quality."

Whether the AirPods 5 will use the H3 chip remains unknown. When Apple introduced the H2, it was initially exclusive to the AirPods Pro lineup.

However, new health sensors are expected to be added to the AirPods 5, and the H3 chip is also a possible option. Beyond that, details about the AirPods 5 remain quite limited. Just as Apple surprised us earlier this year with the AirPods Max 2, their AirPods 5 announcement may be able to bring us surprises as well.

What features do you most want Apple to add to the next generation of AirPods? Let us know in the comments.
